Record Class ArrayTypeName

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.processing.source.ArrayTypeName
Record Components:
componentType - the type of the elements
annotations - the type annotations of the array type itself, written before its brackets, as in String @Nullable []
All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeName
public record ArrayTypeName(TypeName componentType, List<Annotation> annotations) extends Record implements TypeName
The name of an array type, such as String[].

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
